text:
andrew: Quick heads-up — seeing steady KV-cache memory climb on dedicated cluster-42 for long-context workloads (>4k). Paging events start spiking after ~300 tokens; latency jitter follows.

maria: Can you repro on hosted or private? Any config diff?

andrew: Repro on hosted minimal traffic but much slower growth. On private (on-prem with A100s) we see faster fragmentation. Suspect page-size and jemalloc arenas differ.

sahil: Do you have a profiler trace? Kernel selection could be moving heavier kernels for long seqs and increasing KV allocations.

andrew: Attached rough traces — sample shows per-request KV allocs rising, KV reuse rate dropping from 0.93 to 0.65 over long sessions. Also eviction count jumps.

kv-monitor-bot: perf-alert: kv-cache/paging high on cluster-42 (mem_pressure=0.82) — top contributors: longchat-workload, reranker-50.

jordan: Could be config drift: dedicated uses `kv.page_size=65536`, hosted uses `kv.page_size=131072`. Also `kv.reuse_window_ms` differs.

maria: can you paste the two configs?

andrew: Sure:
```
# dedicated
kv.page_size = 65536
kv.eviction_policy = lru
kv.reuse_window_ms = 200

# hosted
kv.page_size = 131072
kv.eviction_policy = lru
kv.reuse_window_ms = 500
```

sahil: That explains reuse: smaller page_size -> more fragmentation -> more frequent evict + re-alloc. On-prem driver settings (NVIDIA) also limit pinned CPU <-> GPU mem mapping which hurts reuse.

maria: Interesting. Any quick mitigation we can try in prod without full rollout?

jordan: Try increasing `kv.reuse_window_ms` to 800 on a canary; also bump `kv.page_size` to 131072 on one dedicated pool. Add `kv.stats=true` to collect per-frame reuse.

andrew: Running canary now on cluster-42/pool-beta. Command I used:
```
runtimectl rollout canary --pool=cluster-42/pool-beta --set kv.page_size=131072 --set kv.reuse_window_ms=800
runtimectl profile --kv --duration=10m --tag=longctx-canary
```

kv-monitor-bot: canary-deploy OK; starting profile job (job-id=kv-9876)

sahil: Also check kernel selection logs — if we keep switching kernels mid-session that may allocate transient KV frames. Add `runtime.debug.kernel_switch=true` for the canary.

maria: Good. Let's wait for the 10m profile then compare `kv.reuse_rate`, `evictions/sec`, `kv_fragmentation_ratio`.

andrew: Will post results. If this stabilizes reuse, we should push a global config and add a migration note for on-prem (driver/pinned memory tweak).

jordan: +1. Put a follow-up in eng-runtime triage for next-week rollout and include cost/regression risk.

andrew: Posted results: reuse_rate up to 0.89, evictions down 70%, paging events almost gone in the canary. Looks promising :tada:

maria: Awesome. Schedule an ops window and start gradual rollout. Add a compatibility note for non-NVIDIA GPUs.

sahil: Also file an infra ticket to standardize `kv.page_size` across hosted/dedicated/private in the model-serving templates.

andrew: Filed: INFRA-3241. I'll update the runbooks.

jordan: Nice work — big perf win.
